name: member__get_savings_balance
description:
Look up a member's details and retrieve their primary savings account balance.
Returns outputs -> primary_savings_balance: currency - The current balance of the member's primary savings account.
May instead return a business outcome: MEMBER_NOT_FOUND, PERMISSION_DENIED, OVERRIDE_REJECTED, VALIDATION_ERROR.
Risk: reversible. Capability member.get_savings_balance@1.0.0 (approved).

name: share__open_account_to_review
description:
Navigates to the New Share Account screen, populates member ID, share type, and initial deposit, and proceeds to the review screen without confirming.
Returns outputs -> none.
May instead return a business outcome: MEMBER_NOT_FOUND, PERMISSION_DENIED, OVERRIDE_REJECTED, VALIDATION_ERROR.
Risk: reversible. Capability share.open_account_to_review@1.0.0 (approved).
